platform_facts.pricing: $1,000 minimum; 10% platform fee (8% verified); no subscription; top up anytime (contentrewards.com/pricing)
platform_facts.payout_models: CPM, per-post, retainer, pool; per-clip min/max payout caps per platform
platform_facts.fraud: Every submission gets a bot-likelihood score before approval; flagged payouts held for review; independent third-party view verification in beta with selected agencies (contentrewards.com/agencies)
platform_facts.approval: Nothing auto-approves; 7-day review window; rejections must cite the written brief; optional pre-post draft review
platform_facts.creator_payout_timing: CPM clip earns 7 days from approval then 3-day hold
platform_facts.licensing: Approved clips licensed to brand perpetual, royalty-free, incl. paid ads (brands-terms 12.2, updated 2026-10-04)
platform_facts.reporting: Views, approved submissions, likes, comments, effective CPM by campaign/platform/day; CSV export; live client link
platform_facts.geo: Campaigns can require audience geography (e.g. 35%+ Germany) and ask creators to share audience demographics
platform_facts.agencies: Agency accounts hold multiple client brands; roles owner/admin/moderator/member
platform_facts.claims_to_attribute: Homepage: 200 agencies, 1M+ creators. Agencies page: Discover gets 2M monthly visits. Treat as company claims.
